title: Limits: decimals at 38 digits, strings and arrays below 2 GB
verdict: `DECIMAL(39)` refused; strings, binaries and arrays under 2³¹ bytes or elements
description: `DECIMAL` precision is at most 38; `DECIMAL(39,0)` raises `DECIMAL_PRECISION_EXCEEDS_MAX_PRECISION` when the query is analysed, and a value past its precision raises (ANSI) or is NULL (spark-decimal-arith): `NUMERIC_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE` when it fits 38 digits but not the type, `NUMERIC_OUT_OF_SUPPORTED_RANGE` when its text has more than 38 digits before the point (a long fraction is rounded to the type first). A string or binary is a byte array indexed by `int`, so it holds less than 2 GB; an array holds at most `Integer.MAX_VALUE - 15` elements; a row must fit a task's memory. Past those, Spark raises (e.g. `COLLECTION_SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`).
reference: The reference caps decimals at 38 digits and raises past them; it has no limit on string, blob or list lengths.

evidence.note: a string's length is an `int` of bytes

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark` runs each query four times on one local session: with `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` true and false, on the folded path (the optimizer evaluates a query over `VALUES` on the driver) and on the codegen path (`ConvertToLocalRelation` and `ConstantFolding` excluded, so the query runs as a job with whole-stage code generation). probes.json keeps one result per ANSI setting where the two paths agree. Spark 4.3.0 (pyspark 4.3.0), Java 21.0.12, Linux x86_64, `local[2]`, session time zone UTC, `spark.sql.timestampType=TIMESTAMP_NTZ`.

evidence.note: the same query with ANSI off is NULL, a `decimal(38,1)`

provenance.notes: Spark's SQL query tests at tag v4.3.0: the golden files under results/ run with ANSI on, those under results/nonansi/ with it off.

evidence.note: text with more than 38 digits in its integral part is no decimal (`null`, then `NUMERIC_OUT_OF_SUPPORTED_RANGE` under ANSI)

notes: `python -m sverify_dev.spark_fuzz --rows 300 --seed 738`: random rows leaning on the fact's edges, each construct run with spark.sql.ansi.enabled on and off, on the folded and the codegen path, and compared with a model of this fact (value, result type, error class). 964 of 964 results as the fact says.
size_limits[0]: 300 rows, `CAST(x AS DECIMAL(38,2))`, 964 of 964 results as the fact says (raised: NUMERIC_OUT_OF_SUPPORTED_RANGE 8, NUMERIC_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.WITH_SUGGESTION 22).
Spark 4.3.0, Java 21.0.12.1, Linux amd64, local[2], session time zone UTC.
